primaryChecks.text: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
primaryChecks.nextContext: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.
